name: check_licence
title: Check a base model's licence
description: Say which licence a base model has and whether it is a permissive open licence, has terms of its own to read, or is unknown. Looks in the preset list and a local model card; with lookup true, also asks the Hugging Face Hub when the policy allows it. Nothing is changed.

model.description: A Hugging Face model id or a local model folder.

revision.description: A commit of the model, when known.

lookup.description: Ask the Hugging Face Hub when the model is not in the preset list.
